title: Tooling: faster ExclusionCircuit and DisjointTensor support masks with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, three leave-two-style expected-support genexprs dominate historical verify wall time:

1. `ExclusionCircuit.verify` — pair leave-two-out over `enumerate(self.inputs)`
2. `ExclusionCircuit.verify_embedding` — reverse-frame leave-two over `sorted(outputs)`
3. `DisjointTensor.verify` — leave-intersecting inputs over k-set bitmasks (`sum(1<<i for i,S if not S&T)`)

This PR replaces each with an equivalent closed form (`full ^ (vertex[a]|vertex[b])` for the ExclusionCircuit paths; `full ^ OR_{p in T} vertex[p]` for DisjointTensor), keeps every support/topology check, and leaves `circuit_sha256` / `dag_sha256` / embedding receipts fieldwise identical.

Certificate `source_sha256` updates are pin-only:
- `scripts/exclusion_circuit.py` on the four ExclusionCircuit binders
- `scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py` on its four binders
- Shared JSON files carry **both** pins so the rewrites do not conflict

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs:

| Path | Median before → after |
|---|---|
| `ExclusionCircuit(45).verify` | **0.092 → 0.008 s (11.08×)** |
| `ExclusionCircuit(45).verify_embedding` | **0.323 → 0.059 s (5.46×)** |
| `DisjointTensor(26).verify` | **1.101 → 0.606 s (1.82×)** |

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate.

Packages: `research/exclusion-support-masks/`, `research/exclusion-embedding-masks/`, `research/disjoint-tensor-support-masks/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/exclusion-support-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/exclusion-support-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/exclusion-support-masks
python3.12 -I -B research/exclusion-embedding-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/exclusion-embedding-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/exclusion-embedding-masks
python3.12 -I -B research/disjoint-tensor-support-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/disjoint-tensor-support-masks/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/disjoint-tensor-support-masks
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_EXCLUSION_SUPPORT_MASKS …
PASS_EXCLUSION_EMBEDDING_MASKS …
PASS_DISJOINT_TENSOR_SUPPORT_MASKS verify_cases=6 mask_cases=7416 certs=4 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE … outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Historical `assert`/`require` gates behave as before under `-O`; digest identity and certificate pin discipline remain the gates. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for these isolated historical-checker changes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994). `DisjointTensor.verify` fully overrides the parent and does not call `ExclusionCircuit.verify`; the closed-form technique is shared, the object and file are not.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the exclusion / shared-point / disjoint-tensor checkers and bit-compression screens. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
